script_text: Pisces, brace yourself — Neptune turns direct in your 12th House this week, dissolving old karmic fog. Monday brings Mercury in Virgo trining your ruling planet Jupiter in your 10th House, sharpening career focus and financial clarity through Wednesday. Tuesday feels hazy with Neptune opposing your natal Moon, so delay major romantic decisions. The turning point hits Thursday when Venus sextiles Pluto in your 7th House, reigniting passion and deepening emotional bonds. Love flourishes Friday as moon trines your descendant, while Saturday's full moon in your 5th House amplifies creative breakthroughs. Sunday brings gentle closure with Neptune stabilizing. Wednesday is your power day because Mercury trines Jupiter in your 10th House, boosting career visibility. Monday is your vulnerable day as Neptune opposes natal Moon, clouding emotions. Trust your intuition over logic this week — your compassionate nature will guide you to abundance. Follow for daily updates.
